WITH exec_counts AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) as exec_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    exec_count,
    exec_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(exec_count) * 1.0 FROM exec_counts) as share
  FROM exec_counts
)
SELECT 
  ordersmark,
  exec_count,
  share,
  share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM with_share) as diff
FROM with_share
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ordersmark IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         diff DESC
LIMIT 10
